claude.sample_unit: simulated mixed Chinese-English pathology dictation audio recordings

links.outcome: Pathologist-coded report-level errors (irrelevant text, Chinese output, factual errors) in LLM-generated reports
links.effect: Total error rates were 16.8% (21/125) for Qwen2:72b, 45.6% (57/125) for Llama3.1:70b, and 92.8% (116/125) for Gemma2:27b.

links.outcome: Comparison of three candidate LLMs on the same transcripts via automated metrics and pathologist ranking
links.effect: Qwen2:72b outperformed Llama3.1:70b and Gemma2:27b across all 5 automated metrics (all P<.001) and had the lowest error rate, showing large differences between candidates.
links.quote: Pairwise Wilcoxon tests showed that Qwen2:72b outperformed Llama3.1:70b and Gemma2:27b across all 5 automated metrics (all P <.001).

unlisted_practices: Contextual vocabulary system message for ASR to reduce transcription error (CER 0.344 to 0.066)
